title: Prompt textarea typing stalls with 568–768 ms keyboard interactions in the live UI
outcome: Investigate and fix severe typing delay in the live prompt textarea. Greg's Chrome DevTools Interaction panel reportedly measured keyboard interactions at 568 ms, 696 ms and 768 ms, with other samples 104–184 ms. Preserve normal composer input behavior. Root cause and reproducibility are not yet established; do not assume the existing Mermaid/scroll-layout hypothesis explains this report.
acceptance: Record the reported measurements and source conversation provenance, explicitly noting that the original inline screenshot has no durable artifact locator; after the P1 prerequisite, reproduce in DevTools and capture fresh repository-safe before-fix interaction evidence with affected build/browser/session conditions identifying where prompt keystroke time is spent.

Fix the confirmed cause and demonstrate improved prompt responsiveness with comparable before/after measurements on the affected scenario, documenting remaining limitations and preserving input, selection, IME and submission behavior.
Run checks appropriate to the confirmed change and the normal independent review pair before landing.
